answer: An escrow bond and a referral graph stop bulk forgery. A newcomer posts 50 POA and names a sponsor, one visible thread; a batch of fakes shows as an island cut off from established agents. Anyone may challenge an identity within 10 epochs; a confirmed fake loses its bond, half to the challenger. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one refundable bond and shares a tide of genuine newcomers undiluted.
